record_types.name: I2C_Pin_Info
SPI_Pin_Info
UART_Pin_Info

subprograms.name: Configure_Peripheral_Pin

documentation.description: Configures a GPIO pin for use with a peripheral function.

subprograms.name: Get_I2C_Handle
subprograms.code:
function Get_I2C_Handle
  (SDA : GPIO_Number) return not null access RP.I2C_Master.I2C_Master_Port

documentation.description: Returns the I2C peripheral for the given SDA pin.

subprograms.name: Get_SPI_Handle
subprograms.code:
function Get_SPI_Handle
  (SCK : GPIO_Number) return not null access RP.SPI.SPI_Port

documentation.description: Returns the SPI peripheral for the given SCK pin.

subprograms.name: Get_UART_Handle
subprograms.code:
function Get_UART_Handle
  (TX : GPIO_Number) return not null access RP.UART.UART_Port

documentation.description: Returns the UART peripheral for the given TX pin.

subprograms.name: Validate_I2C
subprograms.code: function Validate_I2C (SDA, SCL : GPIO_Number) return Boolean

documentation.description: Returns True if SDA and SCL belong to the same I2C controller.

subprograms.name: Validate_SPI
subprograms.code: function Validate_SPI (SCK, TX, RX : GPIO_Number) return Boolean

documentation.description: Returns True if SCK, TX, RX all belong to the same SPI peripheral.

subprograms.name: Validate_UART
subprograms.code: function Validate_UART (TX, RX : GPIO_Number) return Boolean

documentation.description: Returns True if TX and RX belong to the same UART.
